request.style: English, female jazz vocal, warm and soulful, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, mood of ancient heritage, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Nahshon fathered Salma
And Salma fathered Boaz
A name in the line of Judah
Where the ancient roots lay

[Chorus]
Salmon the father of Boaz
By Rahab, by Ruth, by Jesse
The thread of the promise
Is woven with destiny

[Verse]
He married the woman from Jericho
Who hid the spies in the night
Boaz came from this union
And led his people upright

[Chorus]
Salmon the father of Boaz
By Rahab, by Ruth, by Jesse
The thread of the promise
Is woven with destiny

[Bridge]
Obed the father of Jesse
Jesse the father of David
The lineage of the Messiah
In the scriptures is saved

[Outro]
From Nahshon to the end
The story of the seed
Salmon, the father of Boaz
